summary: Swift research program phase 6 after a dive wave: one opus agent harvests the new consolidations, appends the landing report to the topic map, applies the stop condition, and commissions the next wave (revised staged briefs plus follow-ups) or declares ready-to-draft with binding authoring notes
logs: Verdict: ready-to-draft · next wave 0 · IDs 375 · MUST 204 · families 15 · contradictions 31

harvest.verdict_reason: The revised families (GATE, TEST, CONC, CLI) produced no new failure class. Every wave-3 failure mode maps onto one of nine classes, K1-K9, that wave 2 already had. The default-backtracer exit 0 is classified as K1 (a fail-open check), and (e) 19 adds the SW-CORE-16 route row that catches it. No open question that is answerable now would change the text or the verification of a MUST rule. The closest candidate, the trust store of a static musl image, binds only images the owner asks for. N-8 handles it with a SHOULD clause and a self-verifying swift-release step. The rest are owner defaults, measurement this host cannot supply (no macOS or Windows), dated re-checks, or phase-8 real-tree runs. 48 cross-consolidation pairs are resolved in the (e) section, and the authoring notes N-1..N-14 are appended.
frame_corrections: swift:6.2.x images run. [language] R6 and R11 ran 6.2.0, 6.2.2, 6.2.3 and 6.2.4, superseding wave-2 [orch-env] 'no swift:6.2 image'. Only swift:6.0 is unmeasured.
Bazel runs. 8.8.0 and 9.2.0 were installed from the ocx index ([bazel] C5). 'Bazel 8-10' narrows to 8 and 9 measured; 10, 9.3.0 and 8.8.1 are unverified.

ExplicitSendable through SwiftPM gates: .treatWarning("ExplicitSendable", as: .error) exits 1. Every -require-explicit-sendable spelling is inert ([gates] C13, [api] K12). This supersedes the wave-2 'only the swiftc form is verified'.

A trap is not always exit 132. Under the default backtracer, a trap on a non-main thread while main sleeps exits 0 with 'Program crashed:' on stderr. With SWIFT_BACKTRACE=enable=no, or a parked main thread, it exits 132 ([conc] R14, gap f).
weak let compiles from 6.2.3, not 6.3 as SE-0481 says. hasFeature(ImmutableWeakCaptures) is false on every toolchain ([language] R6, R11).
Foundation on Linux: URLSession.bytes(for:) does not exist; timeoutIntervalForResource is a no-op; the per-task redirect delegate is never called; SSL_CERT_FILE is ignored ([network]).

Release premises: GLIBC_2.43 holds per build type, not per image; FoundationEssentials does not shrink a binary (the 45 MB is ICU); swift-subprocess works in a static musl binary; musl gives Task threads a 128 KiB stack ([release]).

Toolchain CLI: migrate takes --target (not --targets) and accepts --scratch-path. swift package audit does not exist. --sbom-spec is new in 6.4. Swift Build drops the environment for plugin commands ([procedures], [release]).
rules_swift .bazelrc:27 is the C++ feature; the Swift gate is swift.treat_warnings_as_errors ([bazel] C3).
The Xcode language mode is read from the project, never assumed. 'Xcode 27 defaults to Swift 5' has a single blog source ([apple]).

authoring_notes: N-1 Globs. swift-quality: ["**/*.swift"]. swift-package: 8 double-quoted entries in order: "**/Package.swift", "**/Package@swift-*.swift", "**/Package.resolved", "**/.swift-format", "**/.swiftformat", "**/.swiftlint.yml", "**/.swift-version", "**/.spi.yml"; no brace globs. Run check-artifacts.py with --root .../exemplars/swift/apple__containerization, --allow-absent for .swiftformat, .swiftlint.yml and Package@swift-*.swift, and --forbid /home/ --forbid .cache/research-lang --forbid swiftlint-sk.sh. Rerun it over bazel-quality after N-13.

N-2 Depth files, one family each, every rule a table row starting with its ID. swift-quality/: language (SW-LANG), concurrency (SW-CONC), errors (SW-ERR), api-design (SW-API), testing (SW-TEST), cli-contract (SW-CLI), io (SW-IO), network (SW-NET), security (SW-SEC), apple (SW-APPLE, read-only). swift-package/: gates (SW-GATE), release (SW-REL). bazel-quality/swift.md (BZL-SWIFT). SW-PKG lives in the swift-package index, SW-CORE in the swift-quality index. All shipped scripts and data go in rules/swift-quality/checks/: k07.sh (SW-CORE-06 form), never-gate.sh, swiftlint-gate.sh, tsan-check.sh, weaken-check.sh, canary.sh, generated-touch.sh, silence-check.sh, fold-check.sh, and the apple oracle and awk files.

N-3 The swift-quality index (under 200 lines) owns SW-CORE-01..06 and 09..21 as one-line rows. It also holds the SW-GATE-01 gate block (commands only), at most 25 non-negotiable lines each ending in an ID, one routing row per family keyed by task words, Siblings (swift-package, code-docs, docs-quality, bazel-quality), and Q1-Q8. The swift-package index owns SW-PKG-01..38 and routes to gates.md and release.md.

N-4 Bounded duplication: rule text once. Duplication is allowed only for the non-negotiables line, the index gate-block copy, and skill Finding tables. K-07 greps live only in checks/k07.sh; .swift-format and .swiftlint.yml only in gates.md; sanitizeForTerminal only in security.md; the exit table only in SW-CLI-01; the TSan job only in SW-GATE-27.

N-5 Pins (measured 2026-10-10): Swift 6.4.0 and 6.3.3; floor leg swift:6.2.0; SwiftLint 0.65.1 SourceKit image; swift-subprocess 1.0.1; ArgumentParser 1.8.x; swift-log 1.16.x; AHC 1.36.2; swift-nio-ssl floor 2.30 (advisory 2.37.2); Static SDK 0.1.0; Bazel 8.8.0 and 9.2.0; rules_swift 4.2.1; rspm 1.25.0. Every default reads 'default; the adopter may override'. Pinned this harvest: Q-T8 goes to SW-API-13; type-check limit 200; escape not strip; D7 and D10 exit 74; the SDK has no logger or downloader; v tags; strip plus unstripped twin; CycloneDX only; the reference SDK package is not shipped.

N-6 Drop: SW-CORE-07 and SW-CORE-08 (authoring checks; retired line in the index); SW-CLI-27 (retired line). Delete the stale clauses listed in Wave 3 (e) 1-17 and wave-2 (e) 2. No run.sh, swiftlint-sk.sh, ~/.cache paths, fixture names or run IDs in shipped text. Rejected claims (@specialize(where:), mapKeyedValues, swift package audit, the GLIBC_2.43-everywhere and 45 MB Essentials claims, unprefixed treat_warnings_as_errors, '#filePath breaks under Bazel', depth 512) appear nowhere.

N-7 SW-CORE-16 gains the route row 'exit 0 + Program crashed: = trap on a non-main thread; rerun with SWIFT_BACKTRACE=enable=no'. SW-CORE-18 gains a per-command test-prefix carve-out for enable=no. Every exit-132 claim names its backtracer setting.

N-8 The shipped swiftlint-gate.sh passes 'lint' to the image with no extra 'swiftlint' word, still exits 70 on 'Skipping enabled rule', and is watched red once. SW-REL-15 keeps its MUST clauses and adds a SHOULD 'copy a CA bundle into the scratch image and make one HTTPS request from it', marked unverified: read only. swift-release carries it as a self-checking step.

N-9 Dating: '(measured 2026-10-10)' or '(read 2026-10-10)'. Floors name their gate: tools version, compiler (patch level: weak let 6.2.3), or corelibs behaviour. Each depth file opens with a versions line. Upstream items are linked with their state: llvm-project#33625 open; swift-build#1764 with fix #1763 merged after 6.4.0; SE-0406 returned; SE-0526 not in 6.4; LLVM PR 203723 closed unmerged.

N-10 Command shape. Explicit directory operand. One -e per alternative; no \| and no -E 'a|b' in a cell; write PCRE angle brackets as \x3C and \x3E. Quote --include and --exclude-dir. No unquoted ** and no $(...): use read -r V < .swift-version in a fenced block. No <placeholder> in patterns. Use xargs -r (it exits 123 when grep -L lists). Put pipes in fenced blocks cited by name (SW-REL-01 b/c, SW-SEC-17 b, SW-TEST-22, SW-CORE-01, SW-NET-08). Say what empty output means, and name exit codes: swift format lint without --strict is 0; TSan 66; tsan-check.sh 1 or 70; swiftlint-gate.sh 70; never-gate.sh 65 or 66; migrate --targets 64; timeout 124. Signal checks use bash set -m.

N-10 The checker's lints: description present, at most 1024 chars, one line, third person, with 'Use when'. Index body at most 200 lines, SKILL.md at most 500. Files over 100 lines need a contents line in the first 40 lines. No broken relative links. Every support .md is named in its index. Stem charset; frontmatter keys at top level; no dead globs. No duplicate ID definitions, and no cited ID left undefined. No empty verification cell. Unescaped pipe count matches the header. No forbidden strings. In code spans: rg without a path operand, rg -L, -tn, escaped \| in rg or grep -E table patterns, unquoted **, <template> in a pattern, $(, a bare dir/* operand, an unquoted --include or --exclude glob.

N-11 Skills are procedures only. swift-upgrade covers SW-CORE-04 and 09-15 (U0..U10), and its description says 'Swift 6 concurrency migration'. swift-diagnose covers SW-CORE-16..21 with references/ from the start. swift-release covers SW-REL plus SW-GATE-20 and the N-8 CA step. A duplicated MUST appears only in a | # | Finding | Rule | table, never as a row starting with the rule ID. Body at most 500 lines; description at most 1024 chars with 'Use when'. Every run ends with the SW-CORE-21 receipt.

N-12 swift-upgrade dated re-checks, one step each: SE-0526; SE-0540 and SE-0529; T-V42; --static-swift-stdlib at 6.4.1+; swift-syntax prebuilts; patch-release syntax; -Werror TemporaryPointers; ImplicitStrongCapture on the oldest leg; the SwiftLint Skipping canary per image bump; LLVM coverage exclusion and .serialized(for:)/.taskLocal at 6.5; MPSC .unbounded; migrate fix-it deprecations; advisory floors; swift-subprocess releases; the type-check limit on a loaded runner; the swift-protobuf 6.4 TSan failure.

N-13 bazel-quality/swift.md: at most 200 lines in the shape of java.md (title and summary, an 'Owns BZL-SWIFT' paragraph, sibling families cited, Contents, the disclosure 'Measured 2026-10-10 against Bazel 8.8.0 and 9.2.0, rules_swift 4.2.1, rspm 1.25.0, Swift 6.4.0', Gaps, What agents get wrong). No glob. In the same change: a routing row and the keywords rules_swift, swift_library, swift_binary, swift_test, swift.toolchain, rules_swift_package_manager; Siblings plus swift-quality and swift-package; *.swift on the never-loads line; publish.toml bazel-quality 0.3.0 to 0.4.0; fix the comment 'twelve … four by language' to fifteen (eight by concern, seven by language); docs/bazel-quality.md 'fourteen' to 'fifteen' at lines 4 and 52.

N-14 The swift-essentials bundle has untagged members swift-quality, swift-package, swift-upgrade, swift-diagnose, swift-release, code-docs and code-docs-cleanup. bazel-quality/swift.md is not a member. Plumbing: docs/<artifact>.md, assets/glyphs/swift.svg and lore-swift.svg, publish.toml entries, the SWIFT_CONSUMER taskfile variable.
